roadmap.title: Clear Tutorial Island and starter progression
roadmap.description: Use an official tutorial-enabled server, finish Tutorial Island, then combine the gathering, crafting, placement, building, clothing, animal, road, Scrap, and research tasks.

roadmap.title: Handle survival meters and mainland monuments
roadmap.description: Fill calories and hydration, recycle empty cans, ride a horse, fight Scientists, then visit Cargo Ship and Oil Rig with prepared transport.

roadmap.title: Group the Instruments, Sunburn, and Voice Props tasks
roadmap.description: Borrow DLC items where possible and use a small boosting group to finish instruments, water combat, photography, dancing, recording, inflatables, and powered audio props efficiently.

roadmap.title: Complete vehicle, monument, fishing, and multiplayer challenges
roadmap.description: Build the specialized car and electrical setups, catch every fish, clear transport and combat challenges, finish NPC missions, and assemble the larger passenger groups.

roadmap.title: Finish the Deep Sea event
roadmap.description: Build a seaworthy boat, enter during an open event, route through Tropical Islands, Floating City, Ghost Ships, and Scientist PT Boats, then finish the swimming and Plank conditions before closure.

achievements.summary: Deploy one Camp Fire on clear ground or a suitable base floor.

guide.context: Rust's starter achievements rely on server-side tracking. Use a Facepunch official server that displays the tutorial task list before investing time.

steps.text: Move @item{Camp Fire} to the hotbar, select it, aim at clear ground or a suitable base floor until the placement preview is valid, and use the primary action to deploy it.

achievements.summary: Finish crafting one Camp Fire through Rust's Crafting menu.

guide.context: Rust's starter achievements rely on server-side tracking. Use a Facepunch official server that displays the tutorial task list before investing time.

steps.text: Press Q to open @mechanic{Crafting}, find @item{Camp Fire} with the search box, supply the recipe shown for the current patch, queue the item, and remain connected until its crafting timer finishes.

guide.context: The Building Plan cannot deploy structures on roads, inside monuments, or within an unauthorized Tool Cupboard radius.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Building Plan}, select a foundation from its build wheel, and place three foundations on valid terrain.

achievements.summary: Upgrade one placed building block to a stronger material with a Hammer.

guide.context: The Hammer's radial menu handles upgrades, repairs, and short-window demolition of your own building blocks.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Hammer}, face one of your placed foundations or walls, hold secondary action, choose an affordable stronger material, and confirm the upgrade.

steps.text: Gather @item{Hemp Fibers} and harvest animal corpses until the inventory contains 50 Cloth.

guide.context: A Hunting Bow keeps distance from dangerous animals, while chickens and deer are safer early targets.

steps.text: Attack one wild @enemy{Animal} with a spear, bow, firearm, or other weapon until the animal dies.

achievements.summary: Fully harvest one dead animal's corpse with a harvesting tool.

guide.context: Bone and combat knives harvest animal corpses more efficiently than the starting Rock.

steps.text: After killing an animal, strike its corpse with a knife, hatchet, or Rock until the corpse is completely depleted.

guide.context: Metal Ore nodes resemble Stone nodes but have a darker, rusty surface.

steps.text: Mine @item{Metal Ore Nodes} with a pickaxe, follow the sparkling impact marker, and retain 300 Metal Ore.

guide.context: This trigger can be delayed; complete the server's starter tutorial first and remain on the road briefly.

steps.text: Find a paved @loc{Road} on the map, step onto its surface, and walk along it until the achievement registers.

achievements.summary: Accumulate at least 65 Scrap from roadside loot or recycled components.

guide.context: Recycling unwanted metal components at a monument is usually faster than relying only on loose Scrap.

steps.text: Loot blue component trays and roadside barrels, then recycle surplus components until the inventory contains 65 Scrap.

achievements.summary: Break ten roadside barrels with weapons or harvesting tools.

guide.context: Roadside junk piles group barrels close together and also supply Scrap for nearby progression tasks.

steps.text: Follow a paved road, destroy every colored @item{Barrel} at its junk piles, and continue until ten barrels have been destroyed.

steps.text: Place an unlearned craftable, such as an electrical Switch, and the displayed Scrap cost into a @item{Research Table}, then activate @mechanic{Research} and collect the resulting blueprint.

achievements.description: Raise the character's calorie bar to its maximum value by eating enough food.
achievements.summary: Raise the character's calorie bar to its maximum value by eating enough food.

guide.context: River valleys commonly supply clusters of Corn and Pumpkins, making them a low-risk route to a full calorie bar.

steps.text: Collect edible @item{Corn} and @item{Pumpkins} near a river, then consume food until the calorie bar is completely full.

achievements.description: Raise the character's hydration bar to its maximum value by drinking.
achievements.summary: Raise the character's hydration bar to its maximum value by drinking.

guide.context: Fresh water from a river or lake avoids the hydration penalty associated with seawater.

steps.text: Stand at a @loc{River or Lake}, face the water, use the drink interaction repeatedly, and stop when the hydration bar is full.

achievements.description: Consume and recycle five empty food cans at a Recycler.
achievements.summary: Consume and recycle five empty food cans at a Recycler.

guide.context: Bean and Tuna cans are common at Abandoned Supermarket, which also contains a convenient Recycler.

steps.text: Loot five cans of @item{Can of Beans} or @item{Can of Tuna}, consume their contents, and keep the empty cans.
Place all five empty cans into a @item{Recycler}, switch it on, and wait for every can to process.

achievements.description: Board the roaming Cargo Ship and reach its bridge at the top of the superstructure.
achievements.summary: Board the roaming Cargo Ship and reach its bridge at the top of the superstructure.

guide.context: Cargo Ship is a timed moving monument; prepare a boat and combat supplies before its map icon appears.

steps.text: Approach the moving @loc{Cargo Ship} by boat and climb one of the ladders on its side.
Fight or avoid the scientists, climb through the upper decks, and enter the enclosed bridge.

achievements.description: Land a Minicopter on the helipad of either Oil Rig monument.
achievements.summary: Land a Minicopter on the helipad of either Oil Rig monument.

guide.context: A Minicopter can be purchased at Bandit Camp; clearing the Oil Rig first gives the pilot a safer approach.

steps.text: Fly a @item{Minicopter} over Small Oil Rig or Large Oil Rig, align with the rooftop @loc{Helipad}, and set the aircraft down on the pad.

achievements.description: Ride a horse for a cumulative distance of one kilometer.
achievements.summary: Ride a horse for a cumulative distance of one kilometer.

guide.context: Wild horses can be claimed with a saddle, and Ranch or Large Barn sells saddles when random spawns are inconvenient.

steps.text: Mount a saddled @npc{Horse} and keep riding across open terrain until the distance tracker reaches 1 km.

achievements.description: Kill five Scientist NPCs on roads or at monuments.
achievements.summary: Kill five Scientist NPCs on roads or at monuments.

guide.context: Military Tunnels and Giant Excavator provide concentrated Scientist groups, while roadside Scientists are safer isolated targets.

steps.text: Kill five @enemy{Scientists} with weapons; use roads for safer single targets or clear a guarded monument for several in one trip.

achievements.summary: Produce notes with an Acoustic Guitar or another playable instrument.

guide.context: The Instruments Pack is not required if another player supplies its instruments; the non-DLC Acoustic Guitar must still be found in world loot.

steps.text: Equip or mount any @item{Instrument}, then use its play controls until the first-note trigger registers.

achievements.summary: Play all eleven instrument types: Acoustic Guitar, Canbourine, Cowbell, Jerry Can Guitar, Junkyard Drum Kit, Pan Flute, Plumber's Trumpet, Shovel Bass, Sousaphone, Wheelbarrow Piano, and Xylobones.

guide.context: The Instruments Pack is not required if another player supplies its instruments; the non-DLC Acoustic Guitar must still be found in world loot.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Acoustic Guitar} from world loot and obtain the ten Instruments Pack instruments by crafting, trading, or borrowing.
Produce at least one audible note on each of the eleven named instruments; deploy the Piano, Drum Kit, and Xylobones before playing them.

achievements.description: Join a four-person-or-larger team with an instrument equipped by every member at the same time.
achievements.summary: Join a four-person-or-larger team with an instrument equipped by every member at the same time.

guide.context: Borrowed instruments work, so only the players supplying crafted instruments need to own the Instruments Pack.

steps.text: Create or join a team of at least four players, give every member an @item{Instrument}, and have all members hold their instruments simultaneously.

achievements.description: Be in a team where every team member is riding a Boogie Board or Inner Tube (minimum 4 members)
achievements.summary: In a filled Above Ground Pool, seat every member of a four-player-or-larger team on four Boogie Boards or Inner Tubes simultaneously.

guide.context: Sunburn items may be borrowed from another player, so pack ownership is not required for the account earning most Sunburn achievements.

steps.text: Fill an @item{Above Ground Pool} with water and place at least four Boogie Boards, Inner Tubes, or a mixture inside it.
Form a team of four or more players and have every team member mount one floating seat at the same time.

achievements.description: Take a photo of another player
achievements.summary: Photograph another player with an Instant Camera.

guide.context: Use a fresh Instant Camera and take the target as the camera's first photograph to avoid the known first-shot tracking quirk.

steps.text: Equip a fresh @item{Instant Camera}, frame another player clearly, and use the shutter to take the photograph.

achievements.description: Equip Sunburn sunglasses, Purple Sunglasses, or Chalk Sunglasses after night has already begun.
achievements.summary: Equip Sunburn sunglasses, Purple Sunglasses, or Chalk Sunglasses after night has already begun.

guide.context: Sunglasses worn before sunset do not satisfy the trigger; unequip them and put them on again during darkness.

steps.text: Wait until the sun is fully down, then move @item{Sunglasses} from the inventory into the face slot.

achievements.description: Splash another player with a Water Pistol while that player is irradiated
achievements.summary: Shoot an irradiated player who is holding a water gun with a Water Pistol.

guide.context: The target needs an active radiation buildup and must hold a water gun for the splash condition to register.

steps.text: Bring a partner to a radiation zone, have the partner equip a water gun, wait for radiation to accumulate, and hit the partner with a @item{Water Pistol}.

achievements.description: Soak another player above the damage threshold using a water gun.
achievements.summary: Raise another water-gun wielder past the wetness damage threshold with water-gun hits.

guide.context: A naked low-health teammate beside a Camp Fire makes the wetness threshold and damage transition easier to observe.

steps.text: Have another player hold a water gun, then keep hitting that player with a filled @item{Water Gun} until wetness exceeds the damage threshold.

achievements.description: Get a kill using a water gun.
achievements.summary: Kill a water-gun-holding player with a Water Pistol or Super Soaker after the target crosses the wetness-damage threshold.

guide.context: Water damage begins only after a water-gun-holding target crosses the wetness threshold, so lower the target's health first.

steps.text: Have a low-health partner equip a water gun, soak the partner past the wetness threshold, and continue firing water until the partner dies.

achievements.description: Get a kill with a super soaker pumped at the lowest pressure.
achievements.summary: Kill a water-gun-holding player after wetness damage begins, pumping the Super Soaker exactly once per emptied burst.

guide.context: Completing this stricter kill can also satisfy the ordinary water-gun kill and soaking achievements.

steps.text: Have a low-health, lightly clothed partner equip a water gun.
Pump the @item{Super Soaker} once, fire until pressure empties, and repeat one-pump bursts without adding extra pressure until the partner dies.

achievements.description: Dance with 2 other players at the front of the Cargo Ship.
achievements.summary: Perform dance emotes with two other players at the bow of the Cargo Ship.

guide.context: All three dancers must own the Voice Props DLC that unlocks dance emotes; borrowing props does not grant those gestures.

steps.text: Board the @loc{Cargo Ship}, gather three DLC-owning players at its front bow, and have all three perform dance emotes simultaneously.

achievements.description: Use a megaphone while in another player's Tool Cupboard radius.
achievements.summary: Speak through a Megaphone while standing inside another player's Tool Cupboard building radius.

guide.context: The Tool Cupboard must belong to a different player; your own authorized building zone does not meet the neighbor condition.

steps.text: Enter another player's building-privilege radius, equip a @item{Megaphone}, hold its transmit control, and speak into the microphone.

achievements.description: Record another player speaking onto a Cassette.
achievements.summary: Record another player's nearby voice onto a Cassette.

guide.context: A Cassette must be inserted in a Cassette Recorder before its recording control becomes available.

steps.text: Insert a @item{Cassette} into a @item{Cassette Recorder}, start recording, and have another nearby player speak before stopping the recording.

achievements.description: Dance near a playing Boom Box on an active Disco Floor.
achievements.summary: Dance on an active Disco Floor connected to a playing Boom Box when a new song begins.

guide.context: The player earning this achievement must own the Voice Props DLC to use a required dance emote; borrowed Boom Box and Disco Floor items are not enough.

steps.text: Power a @item{Boom Box}, route its audio output through at least two powered @item{Disco Floors}, and start music.
Stand on a lit Disco Floor, open gestures with B, choose Twist, Cabbage Patch, or Raise the Roof, and keep dancing through the next song change.

achievements.description: Stare into a laser light for 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Look directly into a powered Laser Light continuously for 30 seconds.

guide.context: Placing the Laser Light low and standing over its beam makes uninterrupted eye contact easier.

steps.text: Connect a @item{Laser Light} to power, face directly into its beam, and hold the view steady for at least 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Listen to the Rust soundtrack from a Boom Box for 30 seconds
achievements.summary: Keep the Boom Box's built-in Rust music selection playing within earshot for 30 uninterrupted seconds.

guide.context: The Boom Box must use its Rust soundtrack selection rather than a cassette or unrelated radio stream.

steps.text: Use either the deployable @item{Boom Box} or its portable version; choose the Rust soundtrack, begin playback, and stay within listening range for 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Play an instrument while floating in an Inner Tube while listening to a Boom Box play a radio stream
achievements.summary: Play an instrument while mounted in an Inner Tube beside a Boom Box playing a live radio stream.

guide.context: A cassette does not count as the radio source; choose an online station from the Boom Box.

steps.text: Place an @item{Inner Tube} in a filled pool, start a live radio stream on a nearby @item{Boom Box}, mount the tube, equip an instrument, and play notes.

achievements.description: Start a fully repaired car with a full set of T3 engine parts
achievements.summary: Start a fully repaired modular car whose module slots are filled and whose engine contains every Tier 3 part.

guide.context: The hidden module-slot condition can be met with two rear passenger modules; the engine also needs fuel before starting.

steps.text: Fill every modular chassis slot, repair the chassis and all modules to maximum health, and add Low Grade Fuel.
Install High Quality Valves, Pistons, Spark Plugs, Carburetor, and Crankshaft in the engine, then start the car.

achievements.description: Plant a different seed in every slot in a Large Planter Box
achievements.summary: Fill all nine slots of one Large Planter Box with nine different seed types.

guide.context: Berry colors count as separate plant types, providing six of the nine distinct seeds needed.

steps.text: Plant Corn, Potato, Pumpkin, Black Berry, Red Berry, Blue Berry, Yellow Berry, Green Berry, and White Berry seeds in separate slots of a @item{Large Planter Box}.

achievements.summary: Catch Anchovy, Catfish, Herring, Orange Roughy, Salmon, Sardine, Small Shark, Small Trout, and Yellow Perch.

guide.context: Freshwater species require swamps or rivers, while Orange Roughy and Small Shark need Underwater Labs or deep-ocean fishing.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Handmade Fishing Rod} from a Fishing Village shop, mission, or crafting.

Catch Anchovy, Herring, Salmon, and Sardine in any water; Catfish and Yellow Perch in rivers or swamps; Small Trout in ocean water; and Orange Roughy plus Small Shark at Underwater Labs or deep ocean.

achievements.description: Travel to an underwater lab with a submarine
achievements.summary: Pilot a submarine from the ocean surface into an Underwater Lab moonpool.

guide.context: Choose a server map that actually contains an Underwater Lab, then buy a submarine at a Fishing Village.

steps.text: Take the driver's seat of a fueled @item{Submarine} at the surface, navigate to an @loc{Underwater Lab}, and drive through one of its moonpool entrances.

achievements.summary: Use the Wave gesture toward five different player characters.

guide.context: The other players do not need to wave back; Outpost and Bandit Camp provide safer places to meet distinct targets.

steps.text: Approach five different players, face each player, open gestures with B, and perform @mechanic{Wave} once per person.

achievements.description: Land a Minicopter on the Cargo Ship
achievements.summary: Set a Minicopter down on the moving Cargo Ship.

guide.context: The trigger checks contact with the ship, but a controlled landing protects the aircraft and crew for the return trip.

steps.text: Match the @loc{Cargo Ship}'s speed in a @item{Minicopter}, approach an open deck from behind, and land with the skids resting on the ship.

achievements.description: Win 3 rounds of poker at Bandit Camp
achievements.summary: Win three poker hands at Bandit Camp.

guide.context: At least one opponent is required, but the opponent may fold each hand to award quick wins.

steps.text: Sit at a @loc{Bandit Camp} poker table with another player, buy into the game, and win three separate hands.

achievements.summary: Finish five NPC missions across Bandit Camp, Fishing Villages, or other quest hubs.

guide.context: Mission credit persists across servers, so separate NPC chains can be combined toward the total.

steps.text: Accept and complete five missions from NPCs; convenient chains include the Bandit Camp lumberjack and a Fishing Village fisherman.

achievements.description: Kill another player with the MLRS
achievements.summary: Kill another player with rockets fired from the MLRS at Abandoned Military Base.

guide.context: The MLRS requires both at least one MLRS Rocket and an MLRS Aiming Module from high-tier loot.

steps.text: At @loc{Abandoned Military Base}, load one or more MLRS Rockets into the rear rack and install an MLRS Aiming Module at the control screen.
Use the screen to aim at another player's position, wait for alignment, leave the screen, and press the red fire button to secure the kill.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Tunnel Dwellers while on a moving work cart
achievements.summary: Kill ten Tunnel Dwellers while riding on a moving Work Cart.

guide.context: The cart must remain in motion when each Tunnel Dweller dies; station icons on the map mark tunnel entrances.

steps.text: Fuel a @item{Work Cart} with Low Grade Fuel, drive through the underground rail network, and kill ten orange-suited @enemy{Tunnel Dwellers} from the moving cart.

achievements.summary: Kill three sharks with a Speargun while underwater.

guide.context: Spearguns function only underwater, and sharks commonly patrol sunken wrecks or investigate bleeding swimmers.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Speargun} and several Spears at Workbench Level 1, locate sharks near underwater wrecks, and deliver the killing shot to three sharks with the Speargun.

achievements.description: Travel 3KM with a companion in a Kayak
achievements.summary: Travel three kilometers in one Kayak with another player seated alongside you.

guide.context: Two paddlers can maintain a straight course by repeatedly paddling on opposite sides; the trip takes roughly 15–20 minutes.

steps.text: Seat two players with paddles in one @item{Kayak}, paddle continuously across open water, and remain together until the distance reaches 3 km.

achievements.description: Watch another player through a CCTV camera
achievements.summary: Observe another player through a powered CCTV Camera from a Computer Station.

guide.context: The Computer Station connects by the exact identifier assigned to the powered camera.

steps.text: Power a @item{CCTV Camera}, assign it an identifier, enter that identifier at a @item{Computer Station}, and keep the feed open while another player is visible.

achievements.summary: Insert Diesel Fuel and start the Giant Excavator.

guide.context: The fuel tank sits in the monument's central machinery, while the start control is reached by nearby stairs.

steps.text: At @loc{Giant Excavator Pit}, place @item{Diesel Fuel} in the large central tank, climb to the adjacent control panel, and press the start button.

achievements.summary: Drop ten vehicles into the Junkyard car shredder with the magnet crane.

guide.context: White trucks already located around Junkyard count, so the player does not need to deliver ten working cars.

steps.text: Operate the @loc{Junkyard} magnet crane, lift ten cars or white trucks one at a time, and release each vehicle into the shredder.

achievements.description: Pilot a Scrap Transport Helicopter with 5 passengers
achievements.summary: Pilot a Scrap Transport Helicopter while five other players ride as passengers.

guide.context: Only the pilot receives credit, so rotate the controls if every group member needs the achievement.

steps.text: Seat five passengers in a @item{Scrap Transport Helicopter}, take the pilot seat, start the aircraft, and fly with all five still aboard.

achievements.description: Drive a modular car with 4 passengers
achievements.summary: Drive a modular car while four other players occupy passenger seats.

guide.context: Two rear passenger modules provide the four additional seats required by the current Steam description.

steps.text: Install two rear passenger modules on a working modular car, seat four other players, take the driver's seat, and move the vehicle.

achievements.description: Acquire a snowmobile in an Arctic Research Base
achievements.summary: Use a Blue Keycard door at Arctic Research Base and mount the Snowmobile stored inside its secured container.

guide.context: The relevant large container is behind a Blue Keycard door, and not every procedural map includes Arctic Research Base.

steps.text: Choose a map with @loc{Arctic Research Base}, bring a @item{Blue Keycard}, open the large secured containers, and mount the Snowmobile inside.

achievements.summary: Finish every objective on Tutorial Island and leave by Kayak.

guide.context: In Options, use Reset Tutorial if necessary, confirm that Start Tutorial is available, then join an official server carrying the Tutorial tag.

steps.text: Complete the survivor's resource, tool, base-building, clothing, combat, barrel, and cooking objectives in the order displayed.
After the final objective, enter the @item{Kayak} and paddle away from Tutorial Island to complete the tutorial.

achievements.description: Open the hidden crate behind Tutorial Island's lighthouse and take its Revolver.
achievements.summary: Open the hidden crate behind Tutorial Island's lighthouse and take its Revolver.

guide.context: Collect the Revolver after the barrel objective but before entering the departure Kayak, because returning can soft-lock the tutorial route.

steps.text: Walk behind the @loc{Tutorial Island Lighthouse}, open the concealed crate, and take the @item{Revolver} before leaving the island.

achievements.summary: Complete and mount a player-built boat containing hull pieces, steering, propulsion, and a sail.

guide.context: At Workbench Level 2, learn Steering Wheel, Sails, Small Boat Engine, Boat Building Plan, and Boat Building Station; an Anchor is optional.

steps.text: Deploy a @item{Boat Building Station} in water, enter edit mode with a Boat Building Plan, and place enough hull sections for the required systems.
Attach a Small Boat Engine, Steering Wheel, and Sail, finish the build, then mount the completed boat.

achievements.description: Hit another boat with a cannon
achievements.summary: Hit a separate boat with a cannonball fired from a player boat or Tropical Island cannon.

guide.context: Deep Sea achievement tracking can fail intermittently even on official servers. If counters remain frozen, fully restart Rust and reconnect after entering the region before retrying.

steps.text: Mount a @item{Cannon} on a player-built boat or approach a Cannon on a Tropical Island, load a cannonball, aim at another boat, and fire until the projectile visibly strikes it.

achievements.summary: Steer a player-built boat through the map-edge Deep Sea entrance while the event is open.

guide.context: The event announces its opening with a horn and shows a three-hour map timer. Since the March 2026 Shipshape patch, RHIBs cannot enter.

steps.text: When @loc{Deep Sea} appears at a map edge, take the helm of a player-built boat, sail into the marked boundary, and remain at the controls during the transition.

achievements.description: Kill a player with a weapon on a stolen PT boat
achievements.summary: Kill another player with a mounted gun on a PT Boat stolen from Scientists.

guide.context: Scientist PT Boats patrol only inside the Deep Sea and carry two mounted .50-caliber weapons that accept standard 5.56 Rifle Ammo.

steps.text: Disable a roaming @enemy{Scientist PT Boat}, kill its crew, board the vessel, and supply 5.56 Rifle Ammo to a mounted gun.
Take control of the mounted gun and kill another player with its fire.

achievements.summary: Consume ten Coconuts gathered from Tropical Islands.

guide.context: Coconuts grow around palms in the Deep Sea. Eating them back on the mainland avoids a reported Deep Sea counter failure.

steps.text: Collect at least ten @item{Coconuts} from Tropical Islands, return through the Deep Sea exit, and consume all ten on the mainland.

achievements.description: Open 5 loot containers on Tropical Islands
achievements.summary: Open five loot containers located on Tropical Islands in the Deep Sea.

guide.context: Crates near island cannons count, and additional containers appear among island ruins.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Tropical Islands} and personally open five previously unopened loot containers near sandbags, cannons, or ruins.

achievements.description: Start opening a locked crate on a Ghost Ship
achievements.summary: Start the hacking timer on a locked crate aboard a Ghost Ship.

guide.context: Only some Ghost Ships carry a locked crate, and Scientist defenders patrol both the deck and nearby water.

steps.text: Find a @loc{Ghost Ship} with a locked timed crate, clear enough Scientists to reach it safely, and activate the crate to begin its hack.

achievements.summary: Enter the dock area of a Floating City in the Deep Sea.

guide.context: Floating Cities are Deep Sea safe zones with docks, vendors, recyclers, workbenches, research tables, refineries, and a central casino.

steps.text: Locate a @loc{Floating City} inside the Deep Sea, sail to its marked harbor, and cross into the dock safe zone.

achievements.description: Swim a total of 200 meters in open water inside the Deep Sea.
achievements.summary: Swim a total of 200 meters in open water inside the Deep Sea.

guide.context: Keep a boat close because the region closes on a timer and severe radiation develops near shutdown.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Deep Sea}, dismount into open water, and swim continuously until the hidden 200 m distance requirement registers.

achievements.description: Jump from a boat's Plank while wearing a Prisoner Hood and locked in Handcuffs.
achievements.summary: Jump from a boat's Plank while wearing a Prisoner Hood and locked in Handcuffs.

guide.context: Another player must apply the Handcuffs after the restrained player raises their hands with the B gesture.

steps.text: Install a @item{Plank} on a boat, equip a Prisoner Hood, stand near the Plank, and use B to raise your hands.
Have another player lock @item{Handcuffs} on you, then walk along the Plank and jump into the water.
